method.nativeQuantum: Use each run's targetRate; a normal 30 FPS frame is approximately 33.3 ms, not a stall.
method.tailClassification: Native terminal uses actual babah; remote tail compatibility uses paired native endpoints and received histories. No remote event identity is exposed.
method.verdict: Metrics only. Unknown-tail repeats require inspection; not an automatic regression or pass.

network.limit: Detailed timestamps cover first 12 events per stream; centered offsets are jitter, not one-way latency.
